name: context-annihilator
description: Personal experiment: summarize a coding-agent task, classify context chunks for relevance in parallel, and hand off a reduced seed to a fresh Claude Code background session.

scripts.package: npm run build && uvx --from aws-sam-cli sam package -t infrastructure/template.yaml --resolve-s3 --output-template-file .aws-sam/packaged.yaml
scripts.deploy: npm run build && uvx --from aws-sam-cli sam deploy -t infrastructure/template.yaml --stack-name context-annihilator --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --resolve-s3 --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
scripts.smoke: tsx test/smoke/pipeline.mts && node scripts/build.mjs && node test/smoke/bundles.mjs
